jobs.title: Operating Room Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

**A Day in the Life of a Operating Room Supervisor**


The Operating Room (OR) Supervisor provides day‑to‑day leadership and operational oversight for the surgical services team, ensuring safe, efficient, and high‑quality perioperative care. This role supports the coordination of staffing, workflow, patient throughput, and regulatory compliance within the operating room environment. The OR Supervisor serves as a key liaison between patients, families, surgeons, anesthesia providers, nursing staff, and support departments. This position promotes excellence in clinical practice, fosters a collaborative team culture, and ensures adherence to all safety, quality, and patient care standards across the perioperative continuum.

**Why Work at Cheyenne Regional?**

* 403(b) with 4% employer match
* ANCC Magnet Hospital
* 21 PTO days per year (increases with tenure)
* Education Assistance Program
* Employee Sponsored Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Loan Forgiveness Eligible

**Here is What You Will Be Doing:**

* Manages OR nursing, support, and secretarial services in absence of the manager to insure complete and competent patient care.
* Coordinates with other organizational patient care services to promote continuity of care and flow of required information.
* Develops, maintains, and oversees the operating room staffing schedule to ensure appropriate coverage based on surgical volume and daily OR needs.
* Collaborates closely with charge nurses to create and manage weekend, holiday, off\-shift, and on\-call schedules to ensure regulatory compliance and efficient workflow across all perioperative services.
* Serves as the first point of contact for nurses, patients, and relatives regarding patient care and related activities.
* Ensures quality of nursing services rendered by the department.
* Participates in pre\-employment interviews and assist with performance evaluations as requested by the Director of Surgery Services.
* Participates in the in\-service training program, including orientation of new nursing personnel and continuing staff development.
* Ensures commitment to department goals/objectives and aids in implementation of strategic plans.
* Assists in development and maintenance of nursing service objectives, standards of nursing practice, nursing policy and procedure manuals.
* Recommends physical facilities, equipment, and supplies needed to carry out operating room nursing services.

**Desired Skills:**

* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to interact with a diverse population
* Knowledge of employee coaching, development, and enhanced performance outcomes
* Knowledge of national trends in hospital quality, patient safety and the changing health care environment
* Ability to independently perform analysis and drive recommendations
* Strategic conceptual thinking skills
* Ability to quickly and calmly handle emergency crisis situations
* Ability to work in a fast paced and changing environment with multiple priorities and objectives
* Ability to use sound judgment/action in patient care decisions
* Ability to identify areas of performance improvement and lead team projects

**Here is What You Need:**

* Wyoming Registered Nurse (RN) License or enhanced Nurse Licensure (eNLC)
* One (1\) or more years of supervisory experience in a critical care setting
* Two (2\) or more years of nursing experience
* Fourteen (14\) Days: Cheyenne Regional AHA RQI within fourteen (14\) calendar days of start date
* One (1\) Year: Certified Perioperative Nurse certification within one (1\) year of being eligible as tracked by the department’s clinical educator. Exceptions may be granted by the Director of Surgery Services.

**Nice to Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited school of nursing
* Lean and/or Six Sigma training
* Surgical Services experience

**About Cheyenne Regional:**


Cheyenne Regional Medical Center was founded in 1867 as a tent hospital by the Union Pacific Railroad to treat workers injured while building the transcontinental railroad. Today, we are the largest hospital in the state of Wyoming, employing over 2,000 people, and treating over 350,000\+ patients from southeastern Wyoming, western Nebraska, and northern Colorado. We pride ourselves on patient and employee experience by living our core values of **I**ntegrity, Cari**n**g, Compa**s**sion, Res**p**ect, Serv**i**ce, Teamwo**r**k and **E**xcellence to great health.


Our team makes a difference every day by providing trusted healthcare expertise through a passionate and **I.N.S.P.I.R.E.(ing)** approach with a personal touch. By living our values, we aim to achieve our goal of becoming a 5\-star rated hospital, providing critical support and resources to our community and the greater region we serve. If you are eager to make a difference and passionate about healthcare, we encourage you to apply today!

jobs.title: Hospice Social Worker
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Hospice Social Worker to join our interdisciplinary care team. In this vital role, you will provide emotional support, counseling, and resource coordination to patients facing end\-of\-life stages and their families. Your expertise will help ensure that patients receive comprehensive, person\-centered care that respects their dignity and wishes. This paid position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals during their most vulnerable moments, while working within a supportive and collaborative environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough patient assessments to identify psychosocial needs, family dynamics, and community resource requirements.
* Provide individual, family, and group counseling sessions focused on coping strategies, grief support, addiction counseling, and behavioral therapy.
* Coordinate with healthcare teams to develop and implement personalized discharge plans that include community resources and home care options.
* Maintain accurate medical documentation in compliance with HIPAA regulations and social work practice standards.
* Facilitate communication between patients, families, medical providers, and community agencies to ensure seamless care delivery.
* Assist with crisis intervention and provide mental health counseling for patients experiencing emotional distress or trauma such as PTSD or dementia\-related behaviors.
* Support clinical research initiatives by collecting data related to patient outcomes and documenting case progress in medical records.

Join us in providing compassionate end\-of\-life care that honors each individual’s journey while supporting their families through challenging times. This role is designed for professionals committed to making a positive impact through clinical excellence and heartfelt service.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $31\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Recruitment/Training Coordinator


**Department:** Human Resources


**Supervisor:** HR/Risk Manager

  


**FULL SALARY RANGE:** $36\.84 \- $50\.60  

**ANTICIPATED HIRING SALARY RANGE:** $36\.84 \- $43\.72


*This is a Full\-time/hourly position*


**BENEFITS:**  

Health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, Life and AD\&D insurance, disability insurance, retirement plans, employee assistance programs, company\-paid training, education reimbursement, vacation accrual, sick leave, and 11 paid holidays.


**REMOTE/HYBRID:**  

Typical schedules are in\-office Monday through Friday. Remote and flexible scheduling may be discussed upon hire and with supervisor approval.


**RELOCATION:**  

This position is located in Greenwood Village, Colorado. Relocation assistance is not provided.

  



**About Greenwood Village**  

Nestled in the heart of the Denver Tech Center, Greenwood Village is a vibrant, engaged community known for beautiful parks, thriving businesses, and exceptional public service. With just over 15,500 residents, the City offers the charm of a small town with the amenities of a dynamic urban center. Our organizational culture is built on integrity, relationships, and ownership—and every employee contributes to the high quality of life our residents enjoy.

  


**About the Role**  

The **Recruitment/Training Coordinator** plays a key role in delivering highly professional Human Resources services. This position coordinates departmental recruitment, selection, training, and development activities; conducts pre\-employment background investigations; supports policy development and compliance; and helps ensure consistency with accreditation standards. The role requires exceptional organization, confidentiality, customer service, and communication skills.

  


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


**A. Recruitment \& Selection**


* Coordinate recruitment activities and advertising for vacant civilian positions
* Develop recruitment materials and screen applications for completeness and relevance to job requirements.
* Prepare applicant correspondence and maintain recruitment records.
* Schedule interviews, assemble interview packets, and develop interview questions.
* Participate as an evaluator on interview panels and administer written exams.
* Prepare interview summaries and respond to applicant inquiries.
* Represent the department at job fairs and recruitment events; educate candidates on hiring processes.
* Coordinate with Police Department recruitment counterparts when needed.


**B. Employment Background Investigations**


* Conduct background investigations for selected applicants and volunteers.
* Review confidential documents, personal history statements, and related records for accuracy and completeness.
* Complete criminal history checks, driver’s license checks, and review records from law enforcement agencies.
* Conduct employment and personal reference checks.
* Review final background results and collaborate with the HR \& Risk Manager on candidate decisions.


**C. Training Program Coordination**


* Organize, implement, and facilitate HR\-related training programs for all City personnel.
* Identify training needs and ensure compliance with federal, state, and City policies.
* Maintain training calendars, coordinate instructors, schedule in\-service training, and issue training memorandums.
* Assist in developing long\- and short\-term training goals and conducting training needs assessments.
* Support departmental budget planning and monitor training expenditures
* Monitor and evaluate training attendance, feedback, and relevance.
* Maintain training records and ensure compliance with retention regulations.
* Provide training data to supervisors for performance evaluations.
* Manage training equipment, classrooms, and related materials.


**D. Budget Responsibilities**


* Provide input for departmental budgets related to training, hiring, conferences, and meetings.
* Track expenditures and process purchasing transactions, including vendor invoices, registrations, lodging, and travel.
* Maintain department budget worksheets and process employee reimbursements.


**E. Miscellaneous Duties**


* Provide support to the HR \& Risk Manager on various assignments
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  


**What We’re Looking For**


**Skills \& Knowledge**


* Strong understanding of training standards, hiring requirements, confidentiality laws, and personnel regulations.
* Knowledge of investigative practices, interview techniques, HR liability and risk mitigation.
* High ethical standards and the ability to maintain confidentiality
* Knowledge of City policies, organizational values, and benefits programs.
* Experience with adult learning principles, training methodologies, and program administration.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including business correspondence and report writing.
* Proficiency in office procedures, recordkeeping, software, and materials development.
* Ability to multitask effectively, work under deadlines, plan long‑ and short‑term activities, and prepare professional presentations.
* Strong organizational skills with systematic filing abilities.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships and communicate clearly.

  


**Education \& Experience Requirements**


* Three years of progressively responsible experience in recruitment and/or training programs.
* Associate’s degree in human resources, business administration, or related field; equivalent experience/training may substitute.
* Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid Colorado driver’s license with a driving record acceptable to the City’s insurance carrier.

**Pay:** $75,000\.00 \- $86,700\.00 per year

**Location:** Arvada, CO

**Schedule:** Full\-Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

**Time off:** Paid Holidays (7 Days), Sick Leave (48 hours per year), PTO (40 hours per year) **PLUS** Paid Center Closures (5 weeks a year)!

**About Us** 

**Evoke Behavioral Health** is a *locally owned* organization that provides specialized educational and therapeutic services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and co\-occurring diagnoses. In 2025, we opened the doors to our newly renovated, state\-of\-the\-art facility in Arvada, CO, complete with two outdoor playgrounds, a full gym, and an advanced sensory room, all designed to enhance client care and staff experience.

Our interdisciplinary team includes BCBAs, LCSWs, Special Education Teachers, RBTs, Educational Assistants, Mental Health Assistants and a large number of graduate students working across our departments. In addition to our comprehensive clinical team, we have on\-site administrative, human resources, nurse and maintenance support to ensure a safe and effective work environment.

**Position Overview** 

The BCBA Clinical Supervisor is responsible for the clinical case management of students in **Evoke’s Secondary/Transition Program**. This role leads the assessment and development of individualized treatment plans, provides supervision and support to Behavior Technicians and Specialists, and ensures data\-driven decision\-making to guide client progress. The Clinical Supervisor also partners closely with families and interdisciplinary teams to promote consistent, **high\-quality care** in alignment with BACB ethical standards and organizational values.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Conduct comprehensive assessments and develop individualized treatment plans
* Maintain a clinical caseload overseeing 800 – 1,000 RBT hours a month.
* Supervise and train RBTs, Behavior Specialists, and BCBA trainees
* Provide parent/caregiver training and support
* Participate in and occasionally lead team and clinical meetings
* Ensure documentation is timely and accurate (e.g., session notes, progress reports, incident documentation)
* Implement and support Safety Care protocols as needed
* Provide in\-the\-moment clinical support and crisis management
* Assist with Secondary Program, as needed.
* Other relevant duties assigned by your supervisor.

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Active BCBA certification in good standing
* Master’s degree in ABA, Psychology, Special Education, or a related field
* Experience training and supervising behavior technicians
* Experience working with children on the autism spectrum and/or with developmental disabilities
* Strong skills in behavior plan development, assessment, and data analysis
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to pass state and federal background checks
* Current CPR/First Aid certification, must obtain within 30 days of employment.
* Physically able to implement Safety Care protocols, including running, kneeling, lifting up to 40 lbs, pivoting, and transitioning from kneeling/seated to standing repeatedly

**Preferred Qualifications** 

* 2\+ years of experience as a BCBA
* Experience with children ages 12\-21
* Experience in treating high\-intensity behaviors
* Experience with co\-occurring diagnoses
* Experience working on an interdisciplinary team
* Familiarity with CentralReach

**Benefits** 

* Paid Time Off and Sick Leave
* Paid holidays!
* Paid Center closures, 5 weeks a year! : 1 week in Spring, 1 week in Summer, 1 week for Thanksgiving and up to 2 weeks in Winter (Christmas/New Year's)!
* Company\-sponsored medical (Anthem), dental, and vision insurance.
* 401(k) with up to a 3% company match.
* CEU and continuing education opportunities (internal and external).
* Health Savings Account (with eligible plan).

Why Join Us?

* Brand new, thoughtfully renovated facility with cutting\-edge resources
* Collaborative, mission\-driven team environment
* Strong administrative and clinical support
* Opportunities for professional growth and leadership

Evoke Behavioral Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position or participate in the hiring process, please contact us at B.fix@evokebehavioralhealth.com.

jobs.title: 988 Colorado Crisis Line (CCL) - Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

  

Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies. **This position is open to current Colorado residents only.**
Hybrid (travel within state) position, 1 day per month in the office. Please note: These working arrangements are subject to change.  

Opt in below to receive text message updates on CDHS recruiting events! **CDHSCareers**
**Description of Job**
----------------------


The 988 Colorado Mental Health Line, organizationally located within the Behavioral Health Administration’s Adult and Youth Program Division, serves as Colorado’s primary front door to immediate behavioral health crisis services. Established pursuant to federal law and state statute, including SB21\-154 and SB25\-236, 988 operates as a TABOR\-defined Enterprise governed by the 988 Enterprise Board and administered by the Behavioral Health Administration. The 988 Colorado Mental Health Line provides Coloradans with 24/7 access to crisis support through call, text, and chat and coordinates connections to additional crisis services when needed. The 988 Enterprise oversees statewide 988 infrastructure and operations, contract performance, quality and compliance, data and evaluation, 988/911 interoperability, public awareness, and coordination with local, regional, state, and national partners. This work supports the development of a high\-functioning crisis response system that connects Coloradans quickly and effectively to the appropriate level of care.


The 988 Program Manager serves as the day\-to\-day operational leader of the 988 Program Team and works under the direction of the 988 Director to translate the strategic priorities of the 988 Enterprise into operational implementation. The position directly supervises the Quality Assurance Administrator, 988/911 Interoperability Administrator, and Data Administrator and is accountable for coordinating work across these functional areas. The Program Manager provides management\-level oversight of contact center performance and vendor operations, quality assurance and compliance, data and performance measurement, 988/911 interoperability, stakeholder engagement, and other initiatives designed to strengthen Colorado’s crisis response system.


A significant responsibility of the Program Manager is representing the 988 program and coordinating program\-level participation in statewide marketing, public awareness, stakeholder engagement, and community outreach activities. Working closely with the 988 Marketing \& Communications Manager and Communications Team, the Program Manager ensures that marketing and outreach efforts are informed by program operations, data, policy, system priorities, and the needs of Colorado communities. The Program Manager serves as a visible representative of 988 with behavioral health providers, public safety agencies and Public Safety Answering Points, healthcare organizations, schools, local and state government, tribal communities, community organizations, and other partners. The position also coordinates participation by Program Team staff when subject matter expertise or program representation is needed.


The Program Manager is expected to exercise sound independent judgment within established authority while maintaining consistent and proactive communication with the 988 Director. The position is responsible for identifying operational risks, barriers, performance concerns, and emerging issues; taking appropriate action within the scope of the position’s authority; and elevating matters requiring Director, executive leadership, or Enterprise Board direction. The Program Manager is accountable for reliable execution and follow\-through on commitments, maintaining continuity of operations when priorities or circumstances change, and ensuring that the Director is appropriately informed of significant operational developments.


The Program Manager provides direct leadership and accountability for the Program Team by establishing clear expectations and priorities, assigning and coordinating work, monitoring performance and deliverables, addressing barriers and performance concerns, and ensuring staff activities remain aligned with Enterprise priorities. The position is responsible for building a collaborative, accountable, and high\-performing team in which employees understand their responsibilities, communicate effectively, meet commitments, and have the support and direction necessary to successfully perform their work.


A central function of this position is operational oversight and continuous monitoring of the statewide 988 contact center contract and other programmatic vendor relationships. The Program Manager monitors vendor performance against contractual requirements, established performance measures, national standards, and Enterprise expectations; identifies areas of noncompliance or performance concern; coordinates performance improvement and corrective action efforts; and makes recommendations to the 988 Director regarding significant vendor or contractual issues. The position works closely with the 988 Finance Team on invoices, contract amendments, procurement activities, grant requirements, and other fiscal and contractual matters to ensure that programmatic and financial oversight remain aligned.


The Program Manager provides operational and technical leadership in the development and implementation of policies, procedures, protocols, and program improvements related to 988 and Colorado’s crisis response system. The position maintains current knowledge of national standards, emerging practices, and developments affecting 988 and crisis services and uses data, quality findings, stakeholder input, and operational experience to identify and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Are you passionate about making a transformative difference in the lives of individuals navigating mental health challenges? We are on the lookout for a dedicated and empathetic Case Manager/Mental Health Worker to assume a pivotal role in providing essential support and care to those seeking help.

**Position Overview:**

As an integral part of our team, you will hold a key position responsible for delivering professional case management services. Our organization is committed to making a lasting impact on individuals' lives, empowering them to overcome mental health challenges and lead fulfilling lives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Conduct thorough assessments and management services, utilizing validated rating scales. Craft individualized behavioral healthcare plans that address behavioral/psychiatric concerns. Adapt plans for patients showing insufficient progress or experiencing changes in their condition. Provide concise psychosocial interventions.

Collaborate closely with the care team and maintain accurate records in the registry. All activities are conducted in consultation with the psychiatric consultant.

Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).

A minimum of 2 years of experience in a behavioral health setting.

Licensed Social Worker (LSW).

Relevant certifications or licensure in mental health (e.g., Certified Mental Health Counselor, Licensed Professional Counselor) are advantageous.

In\-depth understanding of various mental health conditions, therapeutic interventions, and crisis management techniques.

The Implementation Science Program supports leadership\-driven, high impact projects that improve patient outcomes across the Military Health System. Implementation Science works to strengthen cross\-organizational linkages, as well as to instill best practices, and communicate their relevance in the standardization of clinical practice.
What You’ll Do in Your New Role:
**Solution material development*** Plan for and develop a variety of evidence\-based tools and materials that meet the needs of target audiences — materials may be educational or data\-related and may include audio\-visual, print, computer\-aided, computer\-based, or Web\-based formats or applications.
* Develop innovative educational and training materials, including curricula for educational/training sessions or workshops (in\-person or Web\-based) to facilitate and support implementation science.
* Conduct training sessions and workshops in person or online.
* Support accredited continuing education, creative or scientific writing, language translations, and adaptation of materials for special populations.
* Identify concepts for messages, materials, or tools through formative research, including advice and recommendations from target audience members or organizations, primary research, and secondary research analysis.

**Dissemination and implementation*** Execute strategies and tactics for dissemination, including outreach, partnership development, marketing and promotion, technical assistance, and educating and/or training of target audiences.
* Support strategies such as media outreach, learning networks, technical assistance, and one\-on\-one academic detailing as approved by the COR.
* Support the development and execution of an Implementation Plan that promotes adoption of the knowledge solution along with the behavioral and clinical changes associated with its application in clinical and operational settings.

**Assessment and sustainment*** Assess concepts, draft materials, and existing materials using methods that may include focus groups, group testing, professional expert or technical review, one\-on\-one testing, field tests, or pilot tests — all in compliance with the Paperwork Reduction Act.
* Assess the progress and impact of implementation science activities; develop, gather, and analyze appropriate data and metrics, including changes in awareness, understanding, and use of research, materials, and tools among target audiences.
* Incorporate audience feedback, lessons learned, and assessment results into the work for quality improvement and to better meet target audience needs.

**Consultation and enterprise support*** Provide implementation science consultative support to leadership decision making, including support for taskings, responses to directives, reports to Congress, congressional testimony, briefings, updates, and internal and external presentations.
* Support activities that realize and sustain a "community of practice" made up of subject matter experts and implementors from across the MHS.
* Support stakeholders in incorporating elements of implementation science into current practices, and build the capacity of programs to utilize the assessment infrastructure and implement data collection effectively.
* Track level of effort across dissemination, implementation, and assessment elements for inclusion in the Monthly Progress Report.


Required Qualifications:
* Master's level degree, or Certification as a Health Education Specialist, or relevant degree
* Minimum of five (5\) years' experience in assessing individual and population needs; developing, coordinating, implementing, or assessing health education programs or clinical practice guidelines.
* Change Management Professional certification (required within 30 days of contract award)
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Position of Public Trust clearance.
* Experience, knowledge, or demonstrated expertise in applied scientific research, health services research, formative research, health communication, dissemination science, implementation science, technology diffusion, public health education, knowledge acquisition, assessment, evaluation, and evidence\-based tool development.
* Sufficient initiative, interpersonal relationship skills and social sensitivity such that they can relate constructively to a variety of people from diverse backgrounds.
* Excellent time management and communication skills; able to work in a team environment and concurrently support several active projects.

  


Desired Qualifications:
* PMP or Project Management Certification
* Familiarity with DoD and the Military Health System
* Ability to identify, critically review, grade, and synthesize existing scientific evidence.
* Experience developing accredited continuing education content for clinical audiences.
* Familiarity with VA/DoD Clinical Practice Guidelines and clinical quality improvement leading practices.

new_jobs.title: Care Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real\-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

  

A typical day in the Care Coordinator role will include ownership of your patients cases from initiation to closure to include; benefit investigations, prior authorizations / denial appeals, determining financial qualifications for assistance programs and assisting patients or other callers/stakeholders through resolution (via email, inbound/outbound calls and using our patented technology, Lynk) by using your critical thinking skills and your knowledge of the program and industry rules and standards.
